story.title: The recipe behind La Mesillera
paragraphs: La Mesillera started in Terry Evaro's kitchen in Las Cruces, New Mexico. It's a family recipe made for salsa lovers who like it just perfect.

Every jar is pressed for us by The Fresh Chile Co., a commercial food producer right here in Las Cruces. Same recipe, same ingredients, made to commercial food-safety standards. A taste of home, in every jar.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: La Mesillera Jalapeño Salsa ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.
We do not sell products or take payments through this site, and we do not require you to create an account. You can browse every page without giving us any personal information.

If you choose to call, text, or email us to place an order or ask a question, we receive the contact details you share with us, such as your name, phone number, or email address. We use that information only to respond to you and to fulfill orders you ask us to.

To understand how our site is used, we may use privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics that count page visits and show us which pages are popular. This does not identify you personally and does not set advertising or tracking cookies on your device.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share it only with trusted service providers who help us operate the business, such as the commercial kitchen that bottles our salsa, and only to the extent needed to serve you.
You can contact us at any time to ask what information we have about you, to correct it, or to ask us to delete it, and we will do our best to honor your request.
This site is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the "last updated" date shown above.
Questions about this policy? Call or text us at 575-449-6063, or email LaMesilleraJalapenoSalsa@gmail.com.
